;
;       Relaxation package
;
;     PulseSPEL general variables, definitions & conventions
begin defs

; Variables    ; Comments:

p0   = 18      ; 90 pulse length
p1   = 38      ; 180 pulse length
p2   = 38      ; Inversion pulse
p3   = 18      ;

pg   = 2000    ; Integrator Gate Width (RESERVED)
d0   = -600    ; Detection Trigger offset time

d1   = 1000    ; tau
d2   = 4000    ; delay after inversion pulse
d3   = 4000    ;
d4   = 400     ;
d5   = 400     ;

d9   = 0       ; DAF (Delay After Flash) delay pulse sequence until
; after external event (eg. laser pulse)
d30  = 500     ; 1st time scale increment
d31  = 45000   ; 2nd time scale increment

a    = 200     ; (RESERVED) number of transient averages (TRANS)
; if greater than 1024, a must be a multiple of 1024
h    = 1       ; (CONVENTION) number of shots per point (INTG and SPT)
n    = 1       ; (CONVENTION) number of sweeps to accumulate

srt  = 1000 * srtu ; (RESERVED) SRT - Shot Repetition Time (srtu=1.02 us)

b    = 1       ; SRT increment for SRT Recovery
r    = 10      ; Number of 180 pulses for CP-GM sequence
s    = 1       ;
t    = 1       ;

w    = 800     ; (CONVENTION) Split point of sweeps (points)
; i.e. pulse separation where TWT gate pulse can be split.
dx   = 0       ; (RESERVED) 1st time scale starting value
dy   = 0       ; (RESERVED) 2nd time scale starting value
end defs

; Note:
;       Variables Marked 'RESERVED' = variable may be used for other times,
;                                       however only this variable can change
;                                        the indicated parameter.
;                                       eg. only 'a' will change the number of
;                                           transients averaged in SpecJet

;
;
; T2 by 2-Pulse Echo Decay
;
;
begin defs       ; dimension of data array [sx,sy]
dim s[128]      ;  for set-up
dim1 s[256]    ;  for fieldsweep
dim2 s[256]   ;  for echo decay
dim3 s[512,40]   ;  for single shot echo decay
dim4 s[512,128] ;  for echo decay vs. field
dim5 s[128]     ;  for T1 inversion recovery measurement
dim6 s[100]     ;  for Rabi oscillations
dim7 s[20]      ;  for CPMG/XYXY setup
dim8 s[50]      ;  for CPMG/XYXY run
dim9 s[25]      ;  for XY-16
end defs
;
;
begin lists "none"
ph1 +x
ph2 +x
asg1 +a
bsg1 +b
end lists

begin lists1 "2-step"
ph1 +x -x
ph2 +x +x
asg1 +a -a
bsg1 +b -b
end lists1

begin lists2 "16-step"
ph1 +x -x +y -y  +x -x +y -y
ph2 +x -x +y -y  -x +x -y +y  +y -y -x +x  -y +y +x -x
asg1 +a -a +b -b  +a -a +b -b  -a +a -b +b  -a +a -b +b
bsg1 +b -b -a +a  +b -b -a +a  -b +b +a -a  -b +b +a -a
end lists2

begin lists3 "CPMG"
ph1 +x
ph2 +y
ph3 +y
asg1 -a
bsg1 -b
end lists3

begin lists4 "XYXY"
ph1 +x
ph2 +y
ph3 +x
asg1 -a
bsg1 -b
end lists4

begin lists5 "XY-16"
ph1 +x
asg1 -a
bsg1 -b
end lists5

;
; Standing Echo for 2-Pulse Set-Up
;
begin exp "2P ESE Setup" [TRANS QUAD Lists Lists1 Lists2]
; QUAD detection of Transient


shot i=1 to a                ; accumulation loop
d9                          ; DAF (Delay After Flash)
p0 [ph1]                    ; 1st pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
p1 [ph2]                    ; 2nd pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
d0                          ; acquistion delay
dig [sg1]                   ; acquisition
next i                       ; end of accumulation loop

end exp

;
; 2-Pulse Field Sweep
;
begin exp1 "2P ESE Field Sweep" [INTG QUAD Lists Lists1 Lists2]
; QUAD detection with Integration

for k=1 to n                   ; averaging loop
totscans(n)                   ; output of total number of scans

bsweep x=1 to sx              ; field sweep loop
shot i=1 to h                ; accumulation loop
d9                          ; DAF (Delay After Flash)
p0 [ph1]                    ; 1st pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
p1 [ph2]                    ; 2nd pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
d0                          ; constant acquisition delay
acq [sg1]                   ; acquisition
next i                       ; end of accumulation loop

next x                        ; end of field sweep loop

scansdone(k)                  ; output of scans done
next k                         ; end of averaging loop

end exp1

;
; 2-Pulse Echo Decay
;
begin exp2 "2P ESE Decay" [INTG QUAD Lists Lists1 Lists2]
; QUAD detection with Integration

d2=d1                           ; store starting tau value

d1=d2                        ; recall starting tau value
dx=d1                        ; starting tau and assignment of x-axis

sweep x=1 to sx               ; tau sweep loop
shot i=1 to h                ; accumulation loop
d9                          ; DAF (Delay After Flash)
p0 [ph1]                     ; 1st pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
p1 [ph2]                     ; 2nd pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
d0                          ; constant acquisition delay
acq [sg1]                   ; acquisition
next i                       ; end of accumulation loop

d1=d1+d30
dx=dx+d30                    ; x-axis measured from first pulse
dx=dx+d30
next x                        ; end of tau sweep loop

end exp2

;
; Single Shot 2-Pulse Echo Decay
;
begin exp3 "2P ESE Decay Single Shot" [INTG QUAD Lists]
; QUAD detection with Integration

d2=d1                           ; store starting tau value

totscans(n)                   ; output of total number of scans
y = 1

for y=1 to sy

d1=d2                        ; recall starting tau value
dx=d1                        ; starting tau and assignment of x-axis

sweep x=1 to sx               ; tau sweep loop
shot i=1 to 1                ; accumulation loop
d9                          ; DAF (Delay After Flash)
p0 [+x]                     ; 1st pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
p1 [+x]                     ; 2nd pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
d0                          ; constant acquisition delay
acq [sg1]                   ; acquisition
next i                       ; end of accumulation loop

d1=d1+d30
dx=dx+d30                    ; x-axis measured from first pulse
dx=dx+d30
next x                        ; end of tau sweep loop
next y

end exp3

;
; 2-Pulse Echo Decay versus Magnetic Field
;
begin exp4 "2P ESE Decay vs. B0" [INTG QUAD Lists Lists1 Lists2]
; QUAD detection with Integration

d2=d1                           ; store starting tau value

for k=1 to n                   ; averaging loop
totscans(n)                   ; output of total number of scans

bsweep y=1 to sy              ; field sweep loop
d1=d2                       ; recall starting tau value
dx=d1                       ; starting tau and assignment of x-axis

sweep x=1 to sx               ; tau sweep loop
shot i=1 to h                ; accumulation loop
d9                          ; DAF (Delay After Flash)
p0 [ph1]                    ; 1st pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
p1 [ph2]                    ; 2nd pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
d0                          ; constant acquisition delay
acq [sg1]                   ; acquisition
next i                       ; end of accumulation loop

d1=d1+d30
dx=dx+d30                    ; x-axis defined from first pulse
dx=dx+d30                    ;
next x                        ; end of tau sweep loop

next y                         ; end of field sweep loop

scansdone(k)                  ; output of scans done
next k                         ; end of averaging loop

end exp4

;
; T1 by inversion recovery
;
begin exp5 "T1 by Inv Rec" [INTG QUAD Lists Lists1 Lists2]
; QUAD detection with Integration

d2=d3                           ; store starting tau value

for k=1 to n                   ; averaging loop
totscans(n)                   ; output of total number of scans

d3=d2                        ; recall starting tau value
dx=d3                        ; starting tau and assignment of x-axis

sweep x=1 to sx               ; tau sweep loop
shot i=1 to h                ; accumulation loop
d9                          ; 'Delay after flash'
p1 [+x]                     ; Inversion pulse
d3
p0 [ph1]                    ; 1st pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
p1 [ph2]                    ; 2nd pulse and phase program
d1                          ; tau
d0                          ; constant acquisition delay
acq [sg1]                   ; acquisition
next i                       ; end of accumulation loop

d3=d3+d31
dx=dx+d31                    ; x-axis measured from first pulse
next x                       ; end of tau sweep loop

scansdone(k)                  ; output of scans done
next k                         ; end of averaging loop

end exp5

;
; ESE Detected Nutations (Rabi Oscillations)
;
begin exp6 "ESE Rabi-Oscillations" [INTG QUAD Lists Lists1 Lists2]
; QUAD detection with Integration

p4=p3                           ; store original pulse length

for k=1 to n                   ; averaging loop
totscans(n)                   ; output total number of scans

p3=p4                         ; recall original pulse length
dx=p3                         ; define x-axis

sweep x=1 to sx               ; pulse increment loop
shot i=1 to h                ; accumulation loop
d9                          ; DAF (Delay After Flash)
p3 [ph1]                    ; nutation pulse (incremented)
dx                          ; delay during nutation pulse (incremented)
d1                          ; tau
p1 [ph2]                    ; 180 pulse
d1                          ; tau
d0                          ; constant acquisition delay
acq [sg1]                   ; acquisition
next i                       ; end of accumulation loop

p3=p3+d29                    ; increment pulse length
dx=dx+d29                    ; increment axis
next x                        ; end of pulse loop

scansdone(k)                  ; output number of scans completed
next k                         ; end of averaging loop

end exp6

; Carr Purcell Gill Meiboom
;
begin exp7 "CPGM/XYXY SetUp" [TRANS QUAD Lists3 Lists4]
; QUAD detection of Transient

d0=d0-20
r = 1
shot i=1 to a		; accumulation loop
p0 [ph1]			; 1st 90 degree pulse    

for j=1 to r		; 180 pulse loop
d1			; 2*tau
p1 [ph2]			; 180 pulses
d1
d1			; 2*tau
p1 [ph3]			; 180 pulses
d1
next j			; end of 180 pulse loop

d0
dig [sg1]			; acquisition
next i			; end of accumulation loop

end exp7

;
; Carr Purcell Gill Meiboom
;
begin exp8 "CPGM/XYXY Run" [INTG QUAD Lists3 Lists4]
; QUAD detection of Transient

d8=d2*r
d0=d0-20
r=1
d4=d1*l
d4=d4*4
dx=d4

for x=1 to sx
shot i=1 to a		; accumulation loop
p0 [ph1]			; 1st 90 degree pulse    

for j=1 to r		; 180 pulse loop
d1			; 2*tau
p1 [ph2]			; 180 pulses
d1
d1			; 2*tau
p1 [ph3]			; 180 pulses
d1
next j			; end of 180 pulse loop

d0
acq [sg1]			; acquisition
next i			; end of accumulation loop

r=r+l
dx=dx+d4
next x

end exp8

;
; XYXYYXYX-(YXYXXYXY)
;
begin exp9 "XY-16" [INTG QUAD Lists5]
; QUAD detection of Transient 

d8 = d2*r
d0 = d0-20
r = l
d4 = d1*l
d4 = d4*16
dx = d4

for x=1 to sx
shot i=1 to a		; accumulation loop
p0 [ph1]			; 1st 90 degree pulse    

for j=1 to r		; 180 pulse loop
d1			; 2*tau
p1 [+x]
d1
d1
p1 [+y]
d1

p1 [+x]

d1
